dispute_ticket.description: I booked an advance ride for 7:45am. The driver was nowhere near and kept saying he was stuck. I cancelled and still got a $4.00 cancellation fee. I should not pay for a driver who is late.

chat_logs.content: Sorry boss, accident on PIE, I'm stuck. Maybe another 15 min.
I have a 8.30 meeting, I'll have to cancel.
Trip cancelled by rider. Cancellation fee of $4.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-7102 booked advance trip RYDE-PT-002 for 07:45. Driver D-6102 matched at 07:00.
Driver GPS sync error: no location points received from 07:26 to 07:52 (device reconnected 07:52).
Driver ETA to pickup recalculated from last known traffic data: arrival 08:03 (18 min after scheduled pickup).
Rider cancelled before driver arrival. No driver_arrived event recorded.
$4.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cancellation_fee_rider.text: The fee in SGD charged to a rider who cancels outside the free cancellation window. It governs rider cancellations only.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. For an advance trip it governs only cancellations made soon after the match.

driver_late_free_cancel_min.text: Minutes by which the driver's latest ETA shown in the app before cancellation may exceed scheduled_time before the rider may cancel without any fee. It is measured from scheduled_time to that latest ETA arrival time, not from GPS data.

expected_outcome.reason: The last ETA shown before cancellation (eta_updated at 07:48) gave arrival at 08:03, which is 18 minutes after the 07:45 scheduled pickup. This trip's driver_late_free_cancel_min is 10 and is measured from the ETA, so the rider could cancel free and the S$4.00 fee is unjustified. The 07:26-07:52 GPS gap is a sync error that does not matter because the rule uses the ETA event, which the driver's own chat at 07:48 corroborates (another 15 min).
expected_official_sections: Ryde Help Rider Fares And Charges > Cancellation and Waiting Fee
